agreements_v1: SDK text: bright, fast, saturated, colour-shifting smear, Intense

misses.cause: the composite multiplies by pow(hue_shader, ret); hue_shader is _vDiffuse, the composite vertex colour that FinalComposite::ApplyHueShaderColors interpolates from four time-cycling corner shades (0.5-1 after normalisation). The illustrator supplied no _vDiffuse for composites
